A microneedle stamp (or **derma stamp** ) is `a handheld skincare device with a flat head covered in tiny, ultra-fine needles that move in a vertical stamping motion rather than rolling across the skin`.[[1]](https://drpen.net/blogs/blog/how-to-use-a-dermastamp-the-complete-derma-stamp-guide)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2920830317343956027&ibp=oshop)

### How It Works & Benefits

- **Vertical Motion:** Unlike traditional derma rollers that can drag or tear the skin, a vertical stamp enters and exits cleanly to minimize trauma and irritation.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2920830317343956027&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JttiJrbcepM)
- **Collagen Stimulation:** The micro-channels created by the needles trigger the skin's natural healing response, boosting **collagen** and **elastin** production.[[1]](https://skinlaboratory.uk/product/hydra-needle-20-derma-stamp/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:6925625265748466116,catalogid:5049052922177810266,gpcid:13321111991588250006,mid:576462914970981833&ibp=oshop)
- **Enhanced Absorption:** Creating these micro-channels allows serums, growth factors, or hair-growth treatments (like minoxidil) to penetrate deeper and work more effectively.[[1]](https://www.dr-pen.co.uk/product/microneedling-derma-stamp/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ky3B-Fr6sss)
- **Targeted Uses:** Ideal for treating acne scars, fine lines, stretch marks, uneven texture, and thinning hair or patchy beards.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2920830317343956027&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:6925625265748466116,catalogid:5049052922177810266,gpcid:13321111991588250006,mid:576462914970981833&ibp=oshop)

### Common Specifications & Pricing

- **Needle Depth:** Usually adjustable between **0.25 mm and 3.0 mm** depending on the area being treated.
	- *0.25 mm – 0.5 mm:* Best for product absorption and the delicate eye or facial areas.
	- *0.6 mm:* Frequently cited as optimal for scalp hair growth.
	- *1.0 mm – 3.0 mm:* Used for deeper scars or body treatments (depths over 1.0 mm should be approached with caution or left to professionals).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ky3B-Fr6sss)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2920830317343956027&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://drpen.net/blogs/blog/how-to-use-a-dermastamp-the-complete-derma-stamp-guide)[[4]](https://rhutehair.com/blogs/rhute-answers/how-to-use-a-derma-stamp-for-hair-growth-rhute)
- **Popular Options & Cost:** 
	- [Derma Stamp 120+64 Pins Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:652340317608976685,headlineOfferDocid:2920830317343956027,productDocid:2920830317343956027,rds:CSS_PC_15715960337905736081%7CPC_15715960337905736081%7CPROD_CSS_PC_15715960337905736081%7CPROD_PC_15715960337905736081&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiBm87E4KyXAxUj9LsIHTByEBMQxa4PegoIAggACAAIHRAT) (Bio4/Dr.pen style) runs around **£14.99**.
	- [Bioneedle Derma Stamp](https://www.amazon.co.uk/Bioneedle-Derma-Stamp-Professional-Microneedling/dp/B0CWTYZZZ2?source=ps-sl-shoppingads-lpcontext&ref_=fplfs&psc=1&smid=A3BMZOALA7L57A) costs about **£12.00 – £19.99**.
	- [Dr Pen Derma Stamp Micro Needling Skin Tool Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462448711336354,imageDocid:321997232205681414,gpcid:268191246015768588,headlineOfferDocid:887931419092144630,catalogid:5549694213830231810,productDocid:15757687696992621959,rds:CSS_PC_268191246015768588%7CPC_268191246015768588%7CPROD_CSS_PC_268191246015768588%7CPROD_PC_268191246015768588&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiBm87E4KyXAxUj9LsIHTByEBMQxa4PegoIAggACAAIHRAZ) is priced around **£29.00**.[[1]](https://uk.drpen.co/products/derma-stamp-micro-needling-skin-tool)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:2920830317343956027&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:6925625265748466116,catalogid:5049052922177810266,gpcid:13321111991588250006,mid:576462914970981833&ibp=oshop)

### Basic Safety & Usage Tips

- **Sanitisation:** Always soak the stamp head in **70% to 75% isopropyl alcohol** for 5 to 10 minutes before and after each use.[[1]](https://uk.drpen.co/products/derma-stamp-micro-needling-skin-tool)[[2]](https://www.dr-pen.co.uk/product/microneedling-derma-stamp/)
- **Technique:** Press the stamp vertically onto clean skin or scalp, lift up, and move to the next section without dragging or over-stamping the same spot.[[1]](https://purederma.co.uk/products/derma-stamp)[[2]](https://www.dr-pen.co.uk/product/microneedling-derma-stamp/)
- **Aftercare:** Apply a hydrating serum (like hyaluronic acid) immediately after, and avoid active acids, retinoids, or harsh exfoliants for 24 to 48 hours.[[1]](https://www.dr-pen.co.uk/product/microneedling-derma-stamp/)[[2]](https://drpen.net/blogs/blog/how-to-use-a-dermastamp-the-complete-derma-stamp-guide)

To help you choose or use the right tool, let me know:

- **What area are you planning to treat?** (Face, acne scars, scalp/hair growth, or beard)
- **What needle depth or experience level** are you starting with?
